listing.name: Ultra Street Fighter IV — usf4-nx (Thorhax)
listing.summary: The project reports Windows Vulkan boot, menus and fights at 60 FPS. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Ultra Street Fighter IV Xbox 360 disc ISO or extracted full disc files. Plain Xbox 360 ISO or extracted folder; compressed CCI/GOD/ZAR not accepted by advertised browser importer.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: A Windows setup route has not been confirmed. The advertised browser installer downloads a Switch build; it does not supply a Windows game.

warnings: The project reports Windows Vulkan boot, menus and fights at 60 FPS.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
